args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Trip Dates: June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservations and contact information
- Flight information
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone charger and adapter
- Portable power bank

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Hat with wide brim
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Waterproof watch
- Dry bag for valuables

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Small backpack for day trips
- Trail snacks

TOILETRIES:
- Personal medications
- Prescription glasses/contacts
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if desired)
- Lip balm with SPF

ELECTRONICS:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Universal travel adapter

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Small first aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Reusable shopping bags
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach umbrella, cooler
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Trekking poles, energy bars
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Comfortable shoes, respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car snacks, playlist
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt/dress (optional but fun!)
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Quick-dry clothing
- June 19 (Ala Moana shopping): Reusable shopping bags

REMEMBER TO:
- Check luggage weight restrictions
- Verify hotel amenities (hair dryer, iron, etc.)
- Download offline maps of Hawaii
- Save emergency contacts
